name: @activepieces/piece-devin
description: AI-powered engineering assistant for automating development tasks, code generation, and technical conversations.

auth.description: Your Devin API key (used in the Authorization header).

aiMetadata.description: Starts a new Devin AI engineering session from a prompt, kicking off an autonomous coding/technical task. Use this to begin work; capture the returned session id for follow-up actions. Optionally seed the session from a snapshot or playbook, mark it unlisted, or set the idempotent flag so repeat calls reuse an existing session instead of spawning a new one. By default each call creates a new session.

get_session_details.name: get_session_details
get_session_details.description: Retrieves details of a specific Devin session

sessionId.description: The ID of the session to retrieve details for

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the current details and status of an existing Devin session by its session id. Use this to check progress, read results, or poll the outcome of a previously created session. Read-only and idempotent; requires a valid session id.

send_message.name: send_message
send_message.description: Sends a message to a Devin session

sessionId.description: The ID of the session to send the message to

message.description: The message to send to the session

aiMetadata.description: Posts a message into an existing Devin session to give it further instructions, context, or follow-up requests. Use this to continue a conversation with an already-running session rather than starting a new one. Requires the target session id and message text; not idempotent, as each call appends a new message.
